<WORKER-BRIEF>

**Task: audit finding 2A on flutter/flutter#196561 (branch `vcfix-manifest-fallback`, head `7233196849d`)**

An audit agent built a playground app against this PR in 28 configurations. reidbaker asked you to act on its findings. This brief covers finding 2A only. Other findings will reach you in separate briefs, so keep this work in its own commit or commits and don't touch the other findings here.

**The audit's method section, verbatim:**

> **Verification**: Every output APK in `build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/` and `build/app/outputs/apk/` was inspected with `aapt2 dump badging`.

**Finding 2A, verbatim:**

> ### 2A. Following the error message's `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` suggestion when no `versionCode` exists builds **un-installable APKs (`versionCode=''`)**
>
> When neither `android {}` nor `src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` sets a `versionCode`:
> - **Flutter 3.47**: Used `-1` (`variant.mergedFlavor.versionCode`) and silently built APKs with `versionCode='999'`, `'1999'`, `'3999'` (`1000 * abi + (-1)`).
> - **PR #196561**: Fails cleanly (big improvement!), and prints:
>   > `Set versionCode = flutter.versionCode in defaultConfig (or on each product flavor), or pass -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true to keep one versionCode.`
>
> > [!CAUTION]
> > **Escape-Hatch Trap**
> > If the developer follows the second suggestion on that exact project:
> > ```bash
> > flutter build apk --debug --split-per-abi -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true
> > ```
> > the build **exits `0`** and writes `app-armeabi-v7a-debug.apk`, `app-arm64-v8a-debug.apk`, and `app-x86_64-debug.apk` with **`versionCode=''` (empty / missing in the compiled binary `AndroidManifest.xml`)**. `adb install` rejects those APKs on Android devices. Saying *"to keep one versionCode"* when no `versionCode` exists anywhere misleads the user into producing broken APKs.

**Weigh this finding before you change anything. Treat it as input, not proof.**

1. **Reproduce it.** Use a project where neither `android {}` nor `src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` sets `versionCode`. Confirm the PR's error text. Then run the exact command above and record:
   - the exit code
   - the `aapt2 dump badging` output for each APK
2. **Test the "un-installable" claim yourself.** The audit's method section says it only ran `aapt2 dump badging`. It never says it ran `adb install`. As far as I know, Android treats a missing `android:versionCode` as `0` and installs the APK anyway, but I haven't checked. Run `adb install` on each APK on an emulator or device. Report the exact result: success, or the exact failure string. If the APKs install, the finding's severity is wrong. The misleading wording ("to keep one versionCode" when none exists) may still deserve a fix.
3. **Check whether this is a regression.** Run the same `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` command on the base commit (`origin/main`, without the PR). If base also produces `versionCode=''`, the PR didn't cause the flag's behavior. The only new problem is that the PR's error message now points users at the flag. Say which case you found.

**Possible fixes. Choose one based on what you find, and justify it:**

- **(a) Recommended if the problem is mainly the message:** Suggest `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` only when a `versionCode` exists somewhere (gradle or manifest). When none exists, tell the user to set `versionCode = flutter.versionCode`, and stop there. This keeps the PR's scope small.
- **(b)** Also fail the build when the force flag is set and no `versionCode` exists anywhere. This changes the flag's behavior beyond what this PR claims to do. Don't choose it unless step 2 shows the APKs really fail to install, and explain why (a) alone is not enough.
- **(c) Decline:** Only if the evidence shows the current text is accurate and harmless. Explain why.

**Tests:** Add or update a test that checks the error text in the "no versionCode anywhere" case. Make sure it fails before your change and passes after it. If you choose (b), add a test for the flag-plus-no-versionCode case too. Run the relevant Android Gradle and `flutter_tools` tests locally before pushing.

**Rules for this task:**
- Push only to the `reidbaker-agent` fork, on branch `vcfix-manifest-fallback`. Never rebase; add commits on top of the branch.
- Don't post anything on GitHub about this finding. It came from an internal audit, not a review thread. If you think the PR description needs an update, draft the new text in your report and I'll handle it.
- Don't call the PR ready. I'll review your fix diff (`7233196849d..<your head>`) before it goes back to reidbaker.

**What to report back:**
1. Your verdict on 2A: changed, modified, or declined, with one line of reasoning.
2. Evidence from steps 1–3: commands you ran, exit codes, `aapt2` versionCode values, `adb install` output, and the base-vs-PR comparison.
3. The option you chose and why. Include the old and new error text side by side.
4. The test names you added or changed, and proof that each one fails before your change and passes after it.
5. Your new head SHA and the list of commits for this finding.
6. Anything in 2A you think is wrong or overstated, stated directly.
